en: An old sepia-toned postcard view over a small European town in a hilly rural landscape. In the foreground there is a wooden fence, some foliage, and what looks like a barrel or drum lying on its side. The town lies in a valley with clustered houses featuring steep roofs, tree-lined streets, and several church spires rising above the buildings. A prominent large church with a tall pointed steeple stands on the right side. The sky is pale and empty, with some age spots visible on the card. At the top left in red printed letters is the caption 'Neuhausen i. Sa.'
